# Archive of Our Own
> A nonprofit, non-commercial archive for transformative fanworks created by and for fans.

Archive of Our Own (AO3), a project of the Organization for Transformative Works, lets users browse, search, post, bookmark, and organize fanworks across many fandoms and media types.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://archiveofourown.org/): Main entry point for browsing fanworks, news, and site navigation.
- [Fandoms Menu](https://archiveofourown.org/menu/fandoms): Navigation hub for browsing fandom categories by media type.
- [Browse Menu](https://archiveofourown.org/menu/browse): Navigation hub for works, bookmarks, tags, and collections.
- [Search Menu](https://archiveofourown.org/menu/search): Navigation hub for searching works and other archive content.
- [Works](https://archiveofourown.org/works): Browse recently posted and updated works across the archive.
- [Bookmarks](https://archiveofourown.org/bookmarks): Browse public bookmarks saved by archive users.
- [Tags](https://archiveofourown.org/tags): Browse canonical and user-created tags used to organize works.
- [Collections](https://archiveofourown.org/collections): Browse collections and challenges that group related fanworks.

## Search
- [Search Works](https://archiveofourown.org/works/search): Advanced search for works using fandom, relationship, character, tag, and metadata filters.
- [Search Menu](https://archiveofourown.org/menu/search): Starting point for archive search options and navigation.
- [Works](https://archiveofourown.org/works): Browse works without a specific query, with sortable archive listings.
- [Tags](https://archiveofourown.org/tags): Find tags to refine searches and discover related fandom metadata.

## Fandom Directories
- [All Fandoms](https://archiveofourown.org/media): Top-level directory of all fandoms organized by media category.
- [Anime & Manga](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Anime%20*a*%20Manga/fandoms): Browse anime and manga fandoms in the archive.
- [Books & Literature](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Books%20*a*%20Literature/fandoms): Browse book and literature fandoms in the archive.
- [Cartoons & Comics & Graphic Novels](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Cartoons%20*a*%20Comics%20*a*%20Graphic%20Novels/fandoms): Browse comics, cartoons, and graphic novel fandoms.
- [Celebrities & Real People](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Celebrities%20*a*%20Real%20People/fandoms): Browse celebrity and real person fandoms.
- [Movies](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Movies/fandoms): Browse movie fandoms in the archive.
- [Music & Bands](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Music%20*a*%20Bands/fandoms): Browse music and band fandoms.
- [Other Media](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Other%20Media/fandoms): Browse fandoms that do not fit other media categories.

## More Media Categories
- [Theater](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Theater/fandoms): Browse theater and musical fandoms.
- [TV Shows](https://archiveofourown.org/media/TV%20Shows/fandoms): Browse television fandoms in the archive.
- [Video Games](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Video%20Games/fandoms): Browse video game fandoms.
- [Uncategorized Fandoms](https://archiveofourown.org/media/Uncategorized%20Fandoms/fandoms): Browse fandoms not yet assigned to a standard media category.
- [All Fandoms](https://archiveofourown.org/media): Return to the complete fandom directory across all media types.

## Browse & Discovery
- [Works](https://archiveofourown.org/works): Discover fanworks across fandoms with sortable archive listings.
- [Bookmarks](https://archiveofourown.org/bookmarks): Discover works through public user bookmarks and recommendations.
- [Tags](https://archiveofourown.org/tags): Explore archive taxonomy for fandoms, relationships, characters, and additional tags.
- [Collections](https://archiveofourown.org/collections): Explore curated collections, exchanges, and challenge-based groupings.
- [All Fandoms](https://archiveofourown.org/media): Discover fandoms first, then drill down into associated works.

## Account & Access
- [Invitation Requests](https://archiveofourown.org/invite_requests): Request an invitation to create an AO3 account.
- [Home](https://archiveofourown.org/): Access sign-in and general account-related navigation from the homepage.
- [Collections](https://archiveofourown.org/collections): View collection spaces often used for exchanges and community events.
- [Bookmarks](https://archiveofourown.org/bookmarks): Public bookmark listings illustrate user curation features available to accounts.

## Tagging & Organization
- [Tags](https://archiveofourown.org/tags): Central directory for archive tags and canonical tag wrangling results.
- [Works](https://archiveofourown.org/works): View how fandom, relationship, character, and freeform tags organize works.
- [Bookmarks](https://archiveofourown.org/bookmarks): See how bookmarks use tags and notes for personal curation.
- [Collections](https://archiveofourown.org/collections): See how works are grouped into themed or event-based collections.
- [Search Works](https://archiveofourown.org/works/search): Use tags and metadata filters to narrow work discovery.

## Community & Updates
- [Home](https://archiveofourown.org/): Homepage includes current news and links to archive updates.
- [Collections](https://archiveofourown.org/collections): Community-created collections support exchanges, prompts, and fandom events.
- [Bookmarks](https://archiveofourown.org/bookmarks): Public bookmarks surface community recommendations and reading lists.
